new_result.statement_short: For a dependent 3D projection (Z,T) of one product bank and a dependent 2D projection W of a disjoint bank, Q=2 Z^T diag(s1,s2) W + lambda(T+h^TZ+u0)^2+r(Z)+H(X_J) has continuous density bounded by C_*(MN)^(2/5)(s1s2)^(-2/5)|lambda|^(-1/5), C_*=5(675/256)^(1/5). T need not be independent of Z.

target_application: For orthonormal same-bank (Z,T), disjoint orthonormal W, Q_shared=4Z^TW+T^2+X_J^TB_JX_J with ||B_J||<=1/2 has continuous density <6.973; T and Z may be dependent and the matrix is target-valid.
partner_result_applied: Preceding partner fresh-square theorem gives Q_fresh density <6.083 and continuity; newest partner hub-Schur theorem gives <52.256 when |A_00|>=1/16 in its true-near-coloop scope and <176 on its target-valid near-null stress family, with both inequalities stable under disjoint quadratic extensions.
